mapper.sql: select s.id, s.activity_id, s.volunteer_user_id, s.real_name, s.phone, s.organization, s.apply_reason, s.experience, s.status, s.review_reason, s.reviewer_id, s.reviewer_name, s.review_time, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark, a.title as activity_title, a.activity_type, a.service_location, a.start_time as activity_start_time, a.end_time as activity_end_time, a.status as activity_status from vol_activity_signup s left join vol_activity a on a.id = s.activity_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from vol_activity_signup where activity_id = #{activityId} and status = 1
mapper.delete:
delete from vol_activity_signup where id in
#{id}
